params.linkText: expanded its pluggable optical line system (POLS) portfolio

children: with a full C-band, high-power variable-gain amplifier in a compact QSFP form factor for 800G ZR/ZR+ optics.
The enhanced POLS supports up to 32 DWDM wavelengths, enabling up to 25.6Tbps over a single fiber pair across 2km–200km links.
The QSFP-based system integrates key optical transport functions directly into standard transceiver slots, targeting cloud, internet service, and AI infrastructure operators.
POLS delivers 21dBm output power, variable gain, low power consumption, and plug-and-play operation, with automated link configuration and laser-safety management.
Fixed-wavelength and colorless MUX/DMUX options with asymmetric connectors are designed to simplify deployment and reduce fiber-connection errors.
Coherent said the system leverages miniature optical technologies, including dual-chip 700mW uncooled 980nm pump lasers and isolator-tap photodiodes.
The enhanced POLS is generally available and shipping in high volume, with support for 400G and 800G ZR/ZR+ and SFF-8636 or CMIS 4.0 memory maps.

title: Coherent expands pluggable optical line system for AI networks
